Since v0.2.0, `conceptR` contains everything that used to live in `auditR`.
This vignette walks through the audit loop: sample a concept's output, record
reviewer judgments, detect drift, and see how an open drift event blocks
promotion to production.

## Setup

One context carries the bundle, the connection, the acting user and the RBAC
policies. The audit tables are created automatically by `concept_context()`.

```{r}
library(conceptR)
library(duckdb)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb(), ":memory:")

DBI::dbExecute(con, "CREATE TABLE encounters (encounter_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value BOOLEAN)")
DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "encounters",
  data.frame(encounter_id = sprintf("enc_%03d", 1:50),
             value        = rep(c(TRUE, FALSE), times = c(30, 20))),
  append = TRUE)

bundle <- ontologySpecR::bundle(
  bundle_id      = "audit-vignette",
  bundle_version = "0.1.0",
  objects = list(
    ontologySpecR::object_type(
      id           = "Encounter",
      properties   = list(
        list(id = "encounter_id", type = "text"),
        list(id = "value", type = "boolean")
      ),
      primary_key  = "encounter_id",
      source_kind  = "table",
      source_table = "encounters"
    )
  )
)

ctx <- concept_context(bundle, con, actor = "alice")
```

## Roles

Policies map actions to the roles allowed to perform them. Grant roles to
principals before using the gated functions.

```{r}
adt_grant_role(ctx, "alice", "ontology_admin")
adt_grant_role(ctx, "bob",   "auditor")
adt_get_roles(ctx, "alice")
```

## A concept to audit

```{r}
cpt_define(ctx, "ready_for_discharge", "Encounter")
cpt_add_version(ctx, "ready_for_discharge", "flow", "value = TRUE",
                status = "active")
```

## Sample and review

`adt_sample()` evaluates the concept in the database, draws a sample of
objects, and stores it for review.

```{r}
s <- adt_sample(ctx, "ready_for_discharge", "flow", n = 10L)
head(s, 3)

adt_pending_reviews(ctx, "ready_for_discharge", "flow")[, c("sample_id", "object_key")][1:3, ]
```

Reviewers record what they believe the correct value is. Here the reviewer
agrees with the system on the first sample:

```{r}
adt_record_judgment(ctx, s$sample_id[1], reviewer_value = s$system_value[1])
adt_summary(ctx, "ready_for_discharge", "flow")
```

## Drift

If reviewers disagree with the system more often than a threshold over a
rolling window, a drift event is opened. The chunks below are not evaluated when
the vignette is built.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
# Reviewer disagrees with the system on every remaining sample
pending <- adt_pending_reviews(ctx, "ready_for_discharge", "flow")
for (i in seq_len(nrow(pending))) {
  adt_record_judgment(ctx, pending$sample_id[i],
                      reviewer_value = !pending$system_value[i])
}

adt_check_drift(ctx, "ready_for_discharge", "flow", threshold = 0.15)
adt_detect_drift(ctx, "ready_for_discharge", "flow", threshold = 0.15)
adt_drift_status(ctx)
```

## Promotion gate

`cpt_promote(to_stage = "production")` runs the gate. It is blocked when the
actor lacks a permitted role or when the version has an open drift event.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
cpt_promote(ctx, "ready_for_discharge", "flow", 1L, to_stage = "staging")

# Open drift: this errors and the version stays in staging
cpt_promote(ctx, "ready_for_discharge", "flow", 1L, to_stage = "production")

# Resolve the drift event, then promote
drift <- adt_drift_status(ctx)
adt_resolve_drift(ctx, drift$drift_id[1], resolution_notes = "Definition reviewed")
cpt_promote(ctx, "ready_for_discharge", "flow", 1L, to_stage = "production")
```

An emergency override is available with `force = TRUE`. It warns, proceeds and
writes a `forced_promote` entry to the governance log.

## Governance log

Lifecycle and audit actions are written to the governance log.

```{r, eval=FALSE}
adt_get_log(ctx, concept_id = "ready_for_discharge")
adt_governance_report(ctx)
```

```{r, include=FALSE}
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

## Migrating from auditR

`audit_context()` is deprecated. Pass `actor` to `concept_context()` instead, and
call `adt_*` functions with the same context you use for `cpt_*`.
